# apple_in_app_purchase_offer_code_one_time_use_codes (Resource)

Generates a batch of one-time-use codes for an in-app purchase offer code. The codes aren't kept in state; read them with `data.apple_in_app_purchase_offer_code_one_time_use_code_values`. Changing it creates a new one. App Store Connect can't delete codes, so destroying the resource deactivates them. Import it with `<offer_code_id>/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_in_app_purchase_offer_code_one_time_use_codes" "batch" {
  offer_code_id   = apple_in_app_purchase_offer_code.half.id
  number_of_codes = 500
  expiration_date = "2026-06-30"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expiration_date` (String) Last day the codes can be redeemed, e.g. `2026-12-31`.
- `number_of_codes` (Number) Number of redemptions the codes allow.
- `offer_code_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the offer code.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the one-time-use code batch can be redeemed. Deactivating is permanent, so setting it back to `true` creates a new one-time-use code batch. Defaults to `true`.
- `environment` (String) Where the codes work: `PRODUCTION`, `SANDBOX`. Defaults to `PRODUCTION`.

### Read-Only

- `created_date` (String) When the one-time-use code batch was created.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the one-time-use code batch.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_in_app_purchase_offer_code_one_time_use_codes.batch
  identity = {
    offer_code_id = "9876543210"
    id            = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the one-time-use code batch.
- `offer_code_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the offer code.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_in_app_purchase_offer_code_one_time_use_codes.batch 9876543210/1234567890
```
